{
  "settings": [
    {
      "name": "binary_as_string",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "`binary_as_string` | Parquet files generated by legacy writers do not correctly set the `UTF8` flag for strings, causing string columns to be loaded as `BLOB` instead. Set this to true to load binary columns as strings.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "`false`"
    },
    {
      "name": "can_have_nan",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "`can_have_nan` | Whether `FLOAT` and `DOUBLE` columns may contain `NaN` values. When set to true, the reader accounts for `NaN` when using a column's min/max statistics for filter pushdown, since `NaN` does not compare as ordered.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "`false`"
    },
    {
      "name": "encryption_config",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "`encryption_config` | Configuration for [Parquet encryption]({% link docs/current/data/parquet/encryption.md %}).",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "filename",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "`filename` | Whether or not an extra `filename` column should be included in the result. Since DuckDB v1.3.0, the `filename` column is added automatically as a virtual column and this option is only kept for compatibility reasons.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "`false`"
    },
    {
      "name": "file_row_number",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "`file_row_number` | Whether or not to include the `file_row_number` column.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "`false`"
    },
    {
      "name": "hive_partitioning",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "`hive_partitioning` | Whether or not to interpret the path as a [Hive partitioned path]({% link docs/current/data/partitioning/hive_partitioning.md %}).",
      "default_kind": "machine_dependent",
      "default_value": "(auto-detected)",
      "default_evidence": "(auto-detected)"
    },
    {
      "name": "union_by_name",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "`union_by_name` | Whether the columns of multiple schemas should be [unified by name]({% link docs/current/data/multiple_files/combining_schemas.md %}), rather than by position.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "`false`"
    },
    {
      "name": "schema",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "`schema` | Allows you to read a Parquet file as if it has the supplied schema. Field IDs are required.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "NULL",
      "default_evidence": "`NULL`"
    }
  ]
}
